hero_kpi_rationale: Dominion Energy faces significant interest rate risk exposure, with interest rate derivatives valued at $10.7 billion and a $459 million impact on fair value. This exposure is existential to the cost of capital and represents a major risk factor in a volatile rate environment.

kpis.name: Interest Rate Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Value of interest rate derivatives exposing the company to fluctuations in interest rates
kpis.description: Dominion Energy holds interest rate derivatives of significant value. Changes in interest rates can materially impact earnings and the value of interest rate derivatives, especially given substantial variable-rate debt.

kpis.name: Foreign Exchange Risk on CVOW Project
kpis.explanation: Value of fixed-price contracts denominated in foreign currencies (euros and kronor) for the CVOW project
kpis.description: Dominion Energy manages the CVOW commercial project with contracts denominated in euros and Swedish kronor, totaling approximately $2.6 billion and 5.1 billion kronor. Exposure to U.S. dollar fluctuations may generate foreign exchange losses despite partial hedging.

kpis.name: Commodity Price Risk Exposure
kpis.explanation: Exposure to price fluctuations in electricity, natural gas, and other energy products
kpis.description: Dominion Energy is exposed to price changes in electricity, natural gas, and other energy commodities, which may impact its derivatives and margins. The quantified impact ranges between $915 million and $918 million across market scenarios.

kpis.name: Investment Portfolio Market Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Sensitivity of retirement and nuclear decommissioning investment assets to financial market fluctuations
kpis.description: Investment portfolios for retirement and nuclear decommissioning, generating $1.2 billion in returns, are sensitive to financial market movements. A 0.25% decline in returns could impact the company by $28 to $31 million.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Metric tracked annually, historical values maintained for the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $16.51 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $115.86 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $48.94 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of $0.25 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.668 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.278 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years using data from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 76.0% in the latest year.

risks.title: Commodity Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in the 10-K with quantified impacts ($915M to $918M) and significant exposure to electricity and natural gas markets. The language emphasizes direct sensitivity to price fluctuations. The Macro category is weighted as significant.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is prominently highlighted with substantial derivative amounts ($10.7 billion) and a $459M impact on fair value. The intensity of language and growing exposures indicate an existential threat to the cost of capital.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Present for the CVOW project with contracts in euros and kronor ($2.6 billion), and a $35M impact on fair value. Although partially hedged, the risk is recurring and tied to strategic projects.

risks.title: Investment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk pertains to retirement assets and nuclear decommissioning funds, with impacts of $28M to $31M for a 0.25% decline. The size of assets ($1.2 billion in returns) and market sensitivity justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned but deemed unlikely to have a material impact according to management. Credit and collateral policies are robust, mitigating the risk despite the presence of counterparties.

ai_positioning.summary: Dominion Energy does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company does not use AI as a differentiating or strategic element in its operations.
